brief: 5 data tools that turn raw events into shipped product insights.

slots.desc1: Collect user events from every app and touchpoint in real time.
slots.desc2: Warehouse petabytes of raw events without managing infrastructure.
slots.desc3: Transform messy event streams into clean product models with SQL.
slots.desc4: Explore data and share dashboards that the whole team understands.
slots.desc5: Sync modeled insights back into the product and marketing tools.

slots.toolTagline: The customer data platform that collects events from every touchpoint.
slots.bigStatement: Stop building tracking for every tool. One pipeline sends clean events everywhere.
slots.use1Body: Capture clicks, page views and sign-ups with a single SDK.
slots.use2Body: Route events to your warehouse and destinations instantly.
slots.use3Body: Enforce protocols so bad data never breaks downstream models.

slots.toolTagline: Serverless data warehouse built to handle planet-scale event volumes.
slots.bigStatement: Store years of raw events for pennies and query in seconds without ops overhead.
slots.use1Body: Ingest streaming events cheaply alongside structured product tables.
slots.use2Body: Run complex window functions over billions of rows fast.
slots.use3Body: Compute spins up on demand so engineers never tune clusters.

slots.toolTagline: The transformation layer that turns raw events into reliable metrics.
slots.bigStatement: Replace fragile scripts with version-controlled SQL and automated documentation.
slots.use1Body: Build user sessions, funnels and retention tables from raw logs.
slots.use2Body: Assert uniqueness and freshness so dashboards never lie.
slots.use3Body: Preview changes in staging before production tables update.

slots.toolTagline: Open-source BI that lets anyone ask questions without writing SQL.
slots.bigStatement: Democratize product insights so PMs and designers can explore without tickets.
slots.use1Body: Visualize drop-off from signup to activation in two clicks.
slots.use2Body: Analysts can still write queries and share parameterized reports.
slots.use3Body: Drop dashboards into your admin panel for customer-facing insights.

slots.toolTagline: Reverse ETL that moves warehouse insights into the tools teams use daily.
slots.bigStatement: Close the loop by syncing modeled audiences back to CRMs and ad platforms.
slots.use1Body: Push high-intent user lists from SQL to email tools automatically.
slots.use2Body: Trigger in-app messages when data models flag churn risk.
slots.use3Body: Keep one source of truth in the warehouse instead of ten spreadsheets.

slots.toolTagline: Open-source product OS for event capture, analytics and session replay.
slots.bigStatement: Watch exactly how users interact so you can ship with confidence every sprint.
slots.use1Body: Track every click and pageview automatically without engineering work.
slots.use2Body: Measure conversion across onboarding steps and identify friction.
slots.use3Body: Replay user sessions to see where product experience breaks down.

slots.body: Collect, model and ship insights using the same tools top product teams run today. No credit card required.
